modules.name: Interlocked pressure cycle

nodes.name: Inner safety door
nodes.comments: Starts open. Console Choice 1 closes this hatch; only Closed starts the timer.

nodes.name: Exit bulkhead
nodes.comments: Starts closed. Ready opens it; Opened enables the departure threshold.

nodes.name: AURORA computer terminal
nodes.comments: Use opens the console once. Log out resets the latch. Keep enabled so the terminal stays visible; its active state prevents repeated cycles.
nodes.doneText:
AIRLOCK STATUS
Inner hatch sealed. Pressure stable. Outer hatch released.

Proceed through the right-hand exit when ready.

AURORA: All optional lab checks remain available before departure.

nodes.name: AURORA access screen
nodes.comments: Choice 1 seals the inner hatch. Choice 2 logs out and resets the terminal for another visit.
nodes.text:
IDENTITY: CONRAD B. HART
STATUS: UNREASONABLY ALIVE

Outer pressure is balanced. Inner hatch must seal before departure.

Last maintenance note: If the ship starts breathing, contact engineering. If it answers, contact nobody.

Ready to cycle the airlock?
nodes.speaker: AURORA / AIRLOCK 04

nodes.name: Ready for operator
nodes.comments: Initial state in the pressure state group. Cycling automatically exits it.

nodes.name: Equalizing pressure
nodes.comments: Entered after the inner hatch confirms Closed. Starts the delay, valve hiss and warning lamp.

nodes.name: Safe to depart
nodes.comments: Timer completion enters this state, exits Cycling, opens the outer hatch and lights the ready lamp.

nodes.name: Pressure equalization - 3 sec
nodes.comments: 90 simulation ticks at 30 Hz = 3 seconds. Progress is preserved by campaign saves.

nodes.name: Pressure equalized
nodes.text:
INNER HATCH: SEALED
PRESSURE: STABLE
EXIT: RELEASED

You may proceed.

Conrad: An airlock that works. I should have asked for this years ago.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

nodes.name: Departure threshold
nodes.comments: Disabled until the outer door confirms Opened. Entered signals the campaign exit once.

nodes.name: Complete the lab
nodes.comments: Emits route complete, wired to the debrief stage in the Campaign editor.
nodes.text: complete

nodes.comments: Background only. Feet Y is the region bottom. Stop restores the still art; Activate restarts its loop. Pause/save retain phase. Keep the region away from walkable edges.

modules.comments: Terminal -> choice -> inner door Close -> Closed acknowledgement -> Cycling state -> 90-tick timer -> Ready state -> outer door Open. Exit zone is enabled only by Opened. The safety interlock never opens both doors. All pieces belong to this one module.
